name: Windows WDigest Plaintext Credential Caching Disabled
description: Ensures WDigest does not keep plaintext passwords in LSASS memory (UseLogonCredential not set to a non-zero value). The value is absent by default on current Windows, which passes.

remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest /v UseLogonCredential /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\WDigest /v UseLogonCredential
